name: todo-webapp

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Lists, creates, edits, completes, and deletes the signed-in user's to-do entries.

description: Single-page app where a signed-in user manages their own to-do list: add, view, complete, edit, and delete entries. Sign-in is handled by redirecting to Thunder; the app holds no credentials and shows only the caller's own data.
